verdict.rationale: DBOS documents cron-scheduled workflows whose schedules live in the database and can be created, paused, resumed, and deleted at runtime. Conductor's API and the dbosctl CLI can also inspect and drive schedules, which covers cron and pause/resume well. Missing for 10: any evidence of overlap/concurrency policies for scheduled runs, explicit visibility into upcoming run times (only generic 'inspect schedules'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
